mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_circle_supply_profile ( offer_id, version_no, is_current, supply_name, supply_kind, regular_price, action_type, action_value, available_hours, min_people, max_people, duration_minutes, split_booking_allowed, optional_benefit, benefit_rules, checked_at, merchant_rules, workday_evening_covered, single_person_allowed, declared_age_range, guardian_mode, guardian_present_throughout, merchant_childcare_required, adult_child_capacity, price_unit, restrictions, tools_animals_materials, incident_process, cancellation_rule, personal_photo_allowed, photo_allowed_area, tripod_policy, lighting_policy, photo_duration_limit, night_hours, last_entry, alcohol_involved, legal_drinking_age, legal_drinking_age_rule, alcohol_warning, event_end_at ) VALUES ( #{offerId}, #{versionNo}, #{current}, #{supplyName}, #{supplyKind}, #{regularPrice}, #{actionType}, #{actionValue}, #{availableHours}, #{minPeople}, #{maxPeople}, #{durationMinutes}, #{splitBookingAllowed}, #{optionalBenefit}, #{benefitRules}, #{checkedAt}, #{merchantRules}, #{workdayEveningCovered}, #{singlePersonAllowed}, #{declaredAgeRange}, #{guardianMode}, #{guardianPresentThroughout}, #{merchantChildcareRequired}, #{adultChildCapacity}, #{priceUnit}, #{restrictions}, #{toolsAnimalsMaterials}, #{incidentProcess}, #{cancellationRule}, #{personalPhotoAllowed}, #{photoAllowedArea}, #{tripodPolicy}, #{lightingPolicy}, #{photoDurationLimit}, #{nightHours}, #{lastEntry}, #{alcoholInvolved}, #{legalDrinkingAge}, #{legalDrinkingAgeRule}, #{alcoholWarning}, #{eventEndAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_circle_supply_profile SET is_current = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE offer_id = #{offerId} AND is_current = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_circle_supply_profile WHERE offer_id = #{offerId} AND is_current = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM merchant_circle_supply_profile p JOIN merchant_chapter_offer o ON o.id = p.offer_id JOIN cms_topic_chapter ch ON ch.id = o.chapter_id JOIN cms_topic t ON t.id = o.topic_id WHERE o.topic_id = #{topicId} AND p.is_current = 1 AND o.status = 1 AND (o.valid_end IS NULL OR o.valid_end > NOW()) AND ch.circle_enabled = 1 AND t.circle_theme_code IS NOT NULL AND t.is_template = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.user_status = 1 AND t.del_flag = 0 AND ( t.circle_theme_code NOT IN ('FITNESS','MIDLIFE','DATE','FRIENDS','SHANGHAI') OR p.checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) AND ( t.circle_theme_code <> 'NIGHT' OR ( p.checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND (p.supply_kind <> 'EVENT' OR p.event_end_at > NOW()) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, o.topic_id, o.chapter_id, o.merchant_id, ch.circle_candidate_code, ch.name AS candidate_name, ch.circle_role

SELECT p.*, o.topic_id, o.chapter_id, o.merchant_id, ch.circle_candidate_code, ch.name AS candidate_name, ch.circle_role FROM merchant_circle_supply_profile p JOIN merchant_chapter_offer o ON o.id = p.offer_id JOIN cms_topic_chapter ch ON ch.id = o.chapter_id JOIN cms_topic t ON t.id = o.topic_id WHERE o.topic_id = #{topicId} AND p.is_current = 1 AND o.status = 1 AND (o.valid_end IS NULL OR o.valid_end > NOW()) AND ch.circle_enabled = 1 AND t.circle_theme_code IS NOT NULL AND t.is_template = 0 AND t.del_flag = 0 AND ( t.circle_theme_code NOT IN ('FITNESS','MIDLIFE','DATE','FRIENDS','SHANGHAI') OR p.checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) AND ( t.circle_theme_code <> 'NIGHT' OR ( p.checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND (p.supply_kind <> 'EVENT' OR p.event_end_at > NOW()) ) ) ORDER BY ch.sort_id, o.id
